description:
What do today's best sellers in this category have? Winning attributes of a Scan category, no listing needed.
(¿Qué tienen hoy los más vendidos de esta categoría? Atributos ganadores, sin pegar ninguna ficha.)

Full Scan profile: every trait that sets today's best sellers apart from the rest, with the share of each group
that has it (`pct_mas_vendidos`, `pct_resto`), its `tipo` (producto = what the product is or offers, the part
that also works outside Amazon; presentacion = how it is told online; tienda = depends on who sells), whether it
counts in the Wintraits Scan Index, the medians of images, bullets, text length and price (`cifras`), the
index bands and the link to its history. Use it to design or choose a product, brief a manufacturer, set price
and format, or write a listing for Amazon, an own shop or another marketplace. To score a specific listing, use
wintraits_chequeo_rapido. Exploratory snapshot, not validated with an exam: correlation, not causation.

Args:
    categoria: Scan category id (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles, `solo_scan`; e.g. "hidratantes").
    pais: country code (e.g. "ES", "FR", "DE", "IT").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-03-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-mar-2027).
name: wintraits_scan_perfil
